attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo, based on ERA5/Copernicus; CC BY 4.0
timezone_basis: EPW LOCATION timezone field is +1; independently verifying original provider timestamps remains necessary.

units.precipitation_mm_day: mm/day, rain plus snowfall water equivalent

limitations: Gridded ERA5 reanalysis, not measured plot rainfall; grid/version equivalence with original PVGIS data is unverified.
Month source years match EPW labels; the resulting stitched series is not a continuous historical crop season.
PVGIS month selection does not establish representative precipitation or drought statistics.
Adapter explicitly selects liquid rain only; snowfall and delayed snowmelt are excluded.
Open-field precipitation is not automatically effective under-panel rainfall; panel runoff redistribution is not represented.
PP mode remains potential production; adding precipitation does not calculate irrigation requirement or dynamic soil storage.
